genuine50MP.paint: Original 10000x5000 image/source bytes preserved; native-resolution selection coverage is one 7x7 tile; seven independent native-coordinate 8x8 decoded SVG crops agree with native readback and expected paint alpha. This is not a full 50 MP composite SVG decode.
genuine50MP.fullPngWorkflow: Existing editor.e2e.ts import/WASM-edit/save/reopen/full-resolution PNG gate passes separately; timing is a single observation in broad log.

diagnosticsAndCorrections: Initial blanket affine pixel gate failed; all 15 authored circle positions/radii, transformed centroid, continuous union area within 1%, and fully solid/transparent coverage outside a two-local-pixel edge band are independently checked. Alternative SVG arc paths give identical maximum error; cubic circle approximations are worse. Product retains exact circles; diagnostics preserve residual errors.
Stroke support unit fixture initially distinguished negative zero from zero for an empty region; assertion now checks meaningful zero dimensions. No geometry algorithm was weakened.

Actual software-WebGPU numeric rejection retained one real buffer before cleanup. Final case checks every allocated buffer destroyed, no stale output, unchanged document, and a successful independent valid frame afterward.
limitations: Original brush control points/settings and off-support dabs are not SVG brush commands; editable dabs/fills/alpha masks represent rendered geometry. Projects retain complete original data.
Clone snapshots and stroke/layer native coverage remain finite-resolution pixels; complete source snapshots can contain hidden pixels. Source file metadata is excluded.
Dense dabs and deep eraser sequences may exceed viewer XML/filter/memory capacity. Browser calls and individual native jobs remain cooperative rather than preemptible.
Affine/gradient antialiasing and intermediate quantization differ from native Canvas; no universal byte parity or cross-viewer/device fidelity claim.
Software WebGPU runs real WGSL, not hardware GPU performance. No p95/input-to-photon/long-task or whole-process peak-memory claim.
SVG adjustments/Blend If outside filtered native leaves, general SVG import/round-trip, shared symbols/master identity, broader formats and all remaining roadmap requirements remain open.
